name: DRB-HICOM Berhad
overview: 2026年，DRB-HICOM 通过全资子公司 Composites Technology Research Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 收购 Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 全部股权，企业价值为 USD95.2 million，以现金支付，该收购在年内分阶段公告推进。同时，公司与 MIDA、MARii 及 Zhejiang Geely Holding 的谅解备忘录在年内多次更新，均无重大进展。
overview_en: In 2026, DRB-HICOM, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Composites Technology Research Malaysia Sdn. Bhd., acquired the entire equity interest in Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. at an enterprise value of USD95.2 million, satisfied entirely in cash, with the acquisition announced in stages during the year. Meanwhile, the company's memoranda of understanding with MIDA, MARii and Zhejiang Geely Holding were updated several times during the year, with no material development reported.

segments.name: 航空航天与国防
segments.note: 年内推进收购 Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia 全部股权，以扩大航空航天业务。
segments.note_en: During the year, the company progressed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia to expand its aerospace business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就收购 Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia 全部股权发布公告，企业价值 USD95.2 million，全部以现金支付。
actions.text_en: The company announced the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia at an enterprise value of USD95.2 million, to be satisfied entirely in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就收购 Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia 全部股权发布进一步公告，企业价值 USD95.2 million，现金支付。
actions.text_en: The company issued a further announcement on the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia, at an enterprise value of USD95.2 million, satisfied in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述收购发布更新公告，收购对价按 USD95.2 million 企业价值计算，全部以现金支付。
actions.text_en: The company issued an update on the above acquisition, with the purchase consideration derived based on an enterprise value of USD95.2 million, to be satisfied entirely in cash.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Composites Technology Research Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.（DRB-HICOM 全资子公司）拟收购 Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 501,000 股普通股（即全部股权），企业价值 USD95.2 million，全部以现金支付。
actions.text_en: Composites Technology Research Malaysia Sdn. Bhd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of DRB-HICOM, proposed to acquire 501,000 ordinary shares representing the entire equity interest in Spirit AeroSystems Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.
